notes: Scope strictly per task card: severity {low,medium,high,critical} (card contract; spec's warning/error/critical vocabulary maps info->low, warning->medium, error->high), action_owner, optional per-task SLA, stopped_age, deterministic bounded projection. Sticky human/credential/safety gates are never auto-released: the inbox mutates nothing, the dispatcher/cron paths were not touched, and release remains human-unblock or approval-decision only (stage 2). Spec's optional new diagnostics-registry rules (approval_pending_stale, budget_stale, cost_unknown_share P1) are NOT separate registry entries here — the equivalent aging/severity is computed inside the projection (documented decision: the inbox contract and all its acceptance criteria are met by the projection; rule extraction is follow-up work if the diagnostics surface needs to render them independently). Config keys registered in DEFAULT_CONFIG (kanban.diagnostics.*) have runtime readers (kanban_inbox.board_blocked_sla_hours/approval_stale_hours + existing kanban_diagnostics reader).
